2607.05999.title: AgoraSim: A Hybrid Agent-Based Modeling Framework
2607.05999.paper_summary: LLM-agent simulations make natural-language social scenarios easy to instantiate, but their outputs can be overread as predictions and are often difficult to compare with explicit social dynamics. We present AgoraSim, a hybrid agent-based modeling framework for scenario-oriented social reaction analysis. AgoraSim resolves textual or multimodal artifacts into editable ABM configurations, runs ratio-controlled populations that mix LLM, vision-language, custom-endpoint, random, and classical agents, and compares the same scenario against matched classical reference dynamics. All agents emit a shared structured decision object, enabling common action spaces, interaction protocols, metrics, and audit records. Exposed through a local UI, Python SDK/CLI, and REST API, AgoraSim helps users inspect scenario trajectories, compare modeling assumptions, and identify cases that warrant empirical validation.
2607.05999.paper_summary_zh: LLM-agent 模擬使得自然語言社會場景的實現變得簡單，但其輸出可能被過度解讀為預測，並且通常難以與明確的社會動態進行比較。我們提出了 AgoraSim，一個混合的基於代理的建模框架，用於情境導向的社會反應分析。AgoraSim 將文本或多模態的文物解析為可編輯的 ABM 配置，運行混合 LLM、視覺-語言、自定義端點、隨機和經典代理的比例控制人口，並將相同的場景與匹配的經典參考動態進行比較。所有代理發出共享的結構化決策對象，從而實現共同的行動空間、互動協議、度量標準和審計記錄。通過本地 UI、Python SDK/CLI 和 REST API 進行展示，AgoraSim 幫助用戶檢查場景軌跡、比較建模假設，並識別需要實證驗證的案例。
2607.05999.author: Chung-Chi Chen et.al.
